# SLA Calculations

## Summary
Pure SLA arithmetic with no card, template or Ember imports. Business-hours maths (`addBusinessMinutes`, `businessMinutesBetween`, timezone-aware via Intl) runs once in a command when a timer starts, pauses or resumes and is stored as `deadlineAt`; countdown maths (`timerSnapshot`, `urgencyRank`, `TIMER_HUE`, `sortByUrgency`) is cheap and runs constantly.

## API
`ALWAYS_ON`, `zonedParts`, `addBusinessMinutes`, `businessMinutesBetween`, `formatMinutes`, `timerSnapshot`, `urgencyRank`, `TIMER_HUE`, `sortByUrgency`.

## Usage
```ts
import { timerSnapshot, addBusinessMinutes } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/utils/sla';

let snap = timerSnapshot(timer, Date.now());
let deadline = addBusinessMinutes(startedAt, policy.resolutionMinutes, schedule);
```

## Non-goals
No stored state and no clock of its own; callers pass the instant (see SLA Clock).
